map.借款诉讼时效计算器 使用指南: Loan Limitation Period Calculator User Guide
map.输入民间借贷借款到期或约定还款日，依据《民法典》计算诉讼时效届满日，并区分普通与: Enter the due date or agreed repayment date of a private loan and compute the limitation period expiry under the Civil Code, distinguishing ordinary, interrupted and suspended cases, to help the lender judge whether the claim is still protected.
map.填写「出借人主张还款日期（或宽限期届满日）」。: Fill in 'date the lender demanded repayment (or grace period end)'.
map.填写「最后一次催款日期（发送催款函/微信/短信）」。: Fill in 'last demand date (letter / message / SMS sent)'.
map.填写「债务人承诺还款日期」。: Fill in 'date the debtor promised to repay'.
map.约定还款日的借款，从届满日起算 3 年时效。: For a loan with an agreed repayment date, the 3-year limitation runs from the day after it falls due.
map.分期借款从最后一期履行期限届满之日起算。: For installment loans it runs from the day the last installment falls due.
map.未约定还款期的，从出借人首次催款之日起算 3 年。: With no agreed repayment date, it runs 3 years from the day the lender first demands repayment.
map.：借款 2022-01-01、约定 2023-01-01 还，时效自次日起算 3: : borrowed 2022-01-01, agreed to repay 2023-01-01; the limitation runs 3 years from the next day, expiring 2026-01-01.
map.：若 2024 年借款人部分还款，视为同意履行，时效自该日重新计算 3 年，新届: : if the borrower made a partial repayment in 2024, that counts as agreeing to perform, so the limitation restarts for 3 years from that date, expiring around 2027.
map.借条没写还款日怎么办？: What if an IOU has no repayment date?
map.可随时要求还款并给合理期限，时效从你首次主张权利之日起算 3 年；建议留存催款证: You may demand repayment at any time with a reasonable period, and the limitation runs 3 years from the day you first assert the right; keep evidence of demand to fix the starting point.
map.分期借款时效怎么算？: How is the limitation period counted for installment loans?
map.分期履行债务，诉讼时效期间自最后一期履行期限届满之日起计算。: For obligations performed in installments, the limitation period runs from the day the last installment falls due.
